title: My Brother Stole My $98K Wedding Venue, Gave Me $6K. So I Retrieved The Childhood Contract He Forgot.
description: When my brother forged a buyout to sell our barn wedding venue for $840K and tossed me a $6K 'gift', he forgot about the childhood contract we buried in a coffee tin. I retrieved it, voided the sale, and now he rakes haylofts in overalls that say 'You Reap What You Sow' while every wedding contract links to his fraud conviction. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #WeddingVenueDrama
thumb_text: HE NOW WEARS YOU REAP WHAT YOU SOW OVERALLS
pinned_comment: If your brother forged a buyout and sold the wedding venue you built with your $98K 403(b) for $840K, handing you a $6K 'gift', would you have dug up the buried coffee tin to void the sale? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I POURED MY ENTIRE 403(B) INTO A CENTURY OLD BARN
I DUG UP THE BURIED COFFEE TIN
HE NOW WEARS YOU REAP WHAT YOU SOW
